what: ATT-CONTIG (2026-10-23): the binary32 attention's tasks on contiguous copies of their heads' rows, every value as it was -- from BCIR_ATT_CONTIG_FROM positions (1024), where a row of q, k or v holds more than one head, a task given a region of a caller-lent workspace copies its head's rows in (a forward task its query head's q and its KV head's k and v; a backward task its KV head's k, v, dk and dv and each query head's q, dy and dq), runs its head as a batch of one head of one row stride, and copies its results back; the trainer lends its state's workspace under every contract -- measured on the committed tree against the tree before it: the cross-build hashes and the workspace entries against the entries without one, the attention with both units in one process beside the in-place path, the contiguous layout's bound and an A/A control, the copies from a shorter context (the threshold), the decoder's training step, and the GEO study's attention model's training update built as the study builds it, its attention lent the regions, against PyTorch; and the prototype runs: four ways at the traffic in P, none taken, the layout probe and the copies' prototype.
